senses.gloss: f. (cmp. בָּב a. בַּיִת) = h. בָּבָה, [the innermost,] with עֵינָא, pupil of the eye.
units: Targ. O. Deut. XXXII, 10 בָּבַת ע׳ (plur.) the pupils of their (the Israelites’) eyes; [Targ. Y. בבא דעיוניה Ar. (ed. בָּבֵי) the innermost or the gates of His thought, v. בָּב I].
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 7:2">Targ. Prov. VII, 2</cite> <he>בבתא</he> (Ms. <cite ref="B00058"><he>בבייתא</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Ecclesiastes 12:2">Targ. Koh. XII, 2</cite> <he>בבי עינך</he> (some ed. <cite ref="B00942"><he>בני</he></cite>, <cite ref="C00073"><he>גבי</he></cite>, corr. acc.).
